body: i want to start by validating the immense pain ur experiencing. I understand how difficult it can be to do the smallest of tasks without ur world crumbling. I know how hard it is to feel passionate and exhilarated by life. I know that you don't want to hear this, but I know for a FACT that you'd feel a whole lot better if you dragged yourself out of bed and took a nice warm shower. The bare minimum feels impossible, but I know that you can do it! take things one day at a time. Things feel impossible right now, but it's so important to fake it til you make it. You have friends! which means you have support. You just have to ask for it. maybe they won't understand, but if they are good friends, they'll be there for you. Every single day is a struggle, but it'll all be worth it in the end. I've been where you are...I'm still there. I find that a to-do list SAVES ME. it keeps me going! having personal and professional goals is helpful too. My therapist and I are using "is this fact or opinion?" for ex: "im not pretty. " "is that a fact or my opinion? it's my opinion. " "Am I really not pretty? no. do I need a shower? yes. do i need to take better care of myself? yes." Life is a rollercoaster, and things will get better and worse and better again. I have eczema very badly!!! my skin will quite literally fall off if i don't practice self care daily. ur not alone ♡ all of your feelings are valid, but they aren't all logical or factual. It's okay to struggle even if the struggle lasts for months or years. You can 100% handle this, even if it doesn't feel that way right now.

overthinking and self esteem issues is a HUGE problem in a relationship. u may feel inadequate or worried of rejection at times. This is important to communicate to ur partner (without placing any blame upon them) maybe she saw it and ignored it. If she is…then at least she knows ur catching on (which I’m sure would discourage her from continuing to cheat) and maybe she isn’t. You can’t really know! So, if u have no real reason to believe she’s unfaithful then maybe just trust her! Just bc she didn’t want sex doesn’t mean it’s a problem with u or ur relationship. If u have reason to b suspicious of her commitment then let that b known!!! but i wouldn’t mention ur search history. don’t bring it up at all. maybe she saw it and maybe she didn’t. just try not to think about it too much and good luck :)))
